tools.name: check_go_format
tools.description: Check whether named workspace Go files are gofmt-clean without changing them; format_clean is true only when all named files match gofmt output.

tools.name: file_change_history
tools.description: Read up to 20 retained successful file changes in this authorized workspace. Returns change IDs, recorded postcondition hashes and whether exact undo is currently applicable. Never returns preimage contents.

tools.name: find_definitions
tools.description: Find Go declarations for one exact symbol in a workspace directory. Returns signatures and file/line locations from parsed source, not text matches. Reports skipped/unparseable files; bounded to 100 declarations.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find workspace files matching a filename glob; ** matches directories. Results are bounded and sorted.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find semantically resolved Go references to the declaration at path and line. Returns bounded file/line locations and explicitly reports unresolved packages. Never labels plain text matches as symbol references.

tools.name: git_check_ignore
tools.description: Check whether one workspace path is ignored by Git.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Read a bounded Git diff for the worktree, index, or specified commits; optionally narrow it to one path.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Read up to 20 recent commits without changing the repository.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Read a bounded commit patch or summary, optionally for one path.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Read the worktree's branch, HEAD, and Git status without changing it; clean reports whether porcelain status has no tracked or untracked file entries.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List one workspace directory without recursing. If truncated, continue with next_after as start_after.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read one workspace file starting at start_line (default 1), for line_count lines (default 400, maximum 400). Returns total file line_count, full-file SHA-256, actual start/end lines, and next_start_line when more lines remain. Stops at EOF. A missing file returns status NOT_FOUND without reading any alternative; use find_files to discover its actual path. Use read_evidence for evidence IDs.

path.description: Relative path to a workspace file; never an evidence_id.

line_count.description: Number of lines requested, not an ending line number.

tools.name: read_file_from_commit
tools.description: Read the actual file contents at an exact commit SHA in HEAD ancestry, even when that commit did not change the file. This is not a patch. Returns SHA-256 and bounded lines like read_file.

tools.name: search_regex
tools.description: Search workspace text files with a deliberate RE2 regular expression (use | for alternatives and escape literal punctuation). For ordinary literal text, use search_text. Select matching lines, filenames, or a total count. Invalid regex syntax is reported precisely, never reinterpreted as literal text.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find literal text in workspace files. Punctuation such as parentheses, brackets and | is literal; no escaping or regex syntax is needed. Select matching lines, filenames, or a total count. Results are bounded and skipped files reported.
